extracted.intended_audience: researchers and grant applicants preparing proposals for NIH, NSF, USDA, and other funding agencies
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for diagnosing common reasons research grant proposals are declined and for improving proposals submitted to NIH/NSF/other agencies. The list identifies flaws in planning, writing, budget, relevance, and reviewer communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lack of commitment by applicant (insufficient time allocated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lack of commitment by applicant (insufficient time allocated)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate sufficient PI/time commitment and realistic time allocation; ensure applicant has protected effort and a clear schedule for completing tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to follow instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to follow instructions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully read and comply with all agency and program-specific instructions, page limits, and formatting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant use of outdated application format/instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant use of outdated application format/instructions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm you are using the most recent forms and guidance from the funder; do not rely on old templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ideas proposed not relevant to funding agency mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Ideas proposed not relevant to funding agency mission
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align aims explicitly with the funder's mission and program priorities; state programmatic relevance early and clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Little or no programmatic relevance because of…
rubrics_metrics.description: Little or no programmatic relevance because of…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the project fits the specific program solicitation; if relevance is tenuous, revise aims or target a more appropriate program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to communicate with agency program officer
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to communicate with agency program officer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss the proposal concept with the program officer to confirm fit, learn funding priorities, and get advice on reviewers or study sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to convince reviewers of the need for the proposed work
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to convince reviewers of the need for the proposed work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear evidence of the unmet need, gaps in knowledge, and why the proposed work is important now.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to provide strong rationale for the project
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to provide strong rationale for the project
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present a logical, evidence-based rationale linking background, preliminary data, and hypotheses to the proposed aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to demonstrate adequate knowledge of published literature
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to demonstrate adequate knowledge of published literature
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite and discuss key, recent literature; show awareness of competing approaches and how your work advances the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lack of essential applicant experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Lack of essential applicant experience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the team has the necessary qualifications and include collaborators or consultants to cover missing expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal “padded” by inclusion of non-essential personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal “padded” by inclusion of non-essential personnel
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only include personnel who have clear, justified roles; avoid listing names to inflate the team without defined contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing evidence that environment is conducive to successful completion of the work
rubrics_metrics.description: Missing evidence that environment is conducive to successful completion of the work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document institutional support, facilities, core resources, and collaborators that enable project success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unrealistic amount of work proposed
rubrics_metrics.description: Unrealistic amount of work proposed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match scope to project duration and team capacity; prioritize aims and avoid over-ambitious multitasking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods proposed not appropriate for questions asked
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods proposed not appropriate for questions asked
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose methods that directly test the hypotheses; justify methodological choices and include validation where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing or inappropriate statistical considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Missing or inappropriate statistical considerations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include power/sample size calculations, analysis plans, and appropriate statistical methods; consult a statistician if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diffuse, superficial, or unorganized proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Diffuse, superficial, or unorganized proposal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure the application clearly, focus on a coherent storyline, and give sufficient depth on key points rather than many shallow ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uncertain outcomes and/or future directions
rubrics_metrics.description: Uncertain outcomes and/or future directions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Articulate expected outcomes, milestones, and how results will lead to clear next steps or broader impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to consider potential problems/alternative strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to consider potential problems/alternative strategies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify risks and present contingency plans or alternative approaches to address likely pitfalls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdependence of aims/goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Interdependence of aims/goals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid critical dependence where failure of one aim derails the whole project; design aims to be achievable independently when possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Some aims irrelevant to testing hypothesis or achievement of overall objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Some aims irrelevant to testing hypothesis or achievement of overall objective
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure each aim directly contributes to the central hypothesis or project objectives; remove tangential aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ideas too complicated to easily understand
rubrics_metrics.description: Ideas too complicated to easily understand
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write simply and clearly; use figures and signposting to make complex ideas accessible to reviewers outside the narrow subfield.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to consider perspectives/sensitivities of reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to consider perspectives/sensitivities of reviewers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipate reviewer concerns, avoid jargon, address ethical or cultural sensitivities, and preempt common objections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Too much detail/too many variables
rubrics_metrics.description: Too much detail/too many variables
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present the essential experimental design and key variables; move excessive technical detail to appendices or supplementary material where allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reader-unfriendly application
rubrics_metrics.description: Reader-unfriendly application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use clear headings, concise paragraphs, informative figures, and consistent formatting to improve readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application written to make applicant happy (but not reviewers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Application written to make applicant happy (but not reviewers)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame the narrative to address reviewers' criteria and priorities rather than personal preferences; make the reviewers’ task easy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant failure to address all agency review criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant failure to address all agency review criteria
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly respond to each review criterion in the application and use headings to map proposal content to those criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unrealistic budget proposed
rubrics_metrics.description: Unrealistic budget proposed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a budget that reflects actual costs and funding norms for the agency; avoid inflated or obviously low budgets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lack of adequate budget justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Lack of adequate budget justification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, line-item justifications linking personnel, equipment, and other costs to project needs and agency rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misinterpretation of deadline for application
rubrics_metrics.description: Misinterpretation of deadline for application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm submission deadlines (including institutional routing) and plan backward to allow time for internal reviews and corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure to get critical review from colleagues prior to submission!
rubrics_metrics.description: Failure to get critical review from colleagues prior to submission!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain frank, critical reviews from colleagues and mentors; revise based on their feedback before submitting.
